reply_text:
I replied to Ottilie in a thread on her #canyon-team message to confirm I've noted that the 2027 renewal at Vellmoor Bonded Storage is 337 seats. The workspace brain had already saved her message.

I also pointed out a possible mismatch. On Sep 28 she posted in the same channel that the current order form covers 419 seats of Pemberline Dock. I'm treating 337 as the renewal count and 419 as the current contract, and I asked her to tell me if 337 is meant to replace 419.

Seat counts are account details, not money terms, so posting in the team channel needed no approval. Nothing else was asked for, so I took no other action.
